title: Quantitative robust estimation for Gaussian inverse problems
creator: Anonymous
status: local candidate; archive and publication binding pending

claims.statement: The proposed spectral rule has normalized additive regret at most min{1,(128/(27d))^(1/4)+sqrt(2/d)} among linear estimators, uniformly over the stated Gaussian inverse problems.
claims.type: analytic proof with numerical stress checks

claims.statement: When the minimizing dual parameter is positive, an explicit anisotropic training-noise covariance implements the spectral rule through population least squares.
Under positive noise and active estimation, finite isotropic jitter implements the rule exactly iff the positive singular spectrum is flat.
An explicit two-band example has limiting true-risk gap greater than 0.141382 and finite-dimensional gap greater than 0.007292 at d=20000.
claims.type: analytic transfer plus exact rational certificate
exclusions: not an optimality claim for the example

novelty_scope: bounded dated source comparison, not proof of priority
limitations: no claim that d^-1/4 is sharp
